name: Cloud Backup for Podio
description: Backup and restore for all data and files stored in Podio, the work-management platform now owned by Progress. It runs regular automatic backups that you manage in a web UI. 100 MB free, then paid plans for automatic/recurring backups and bigger sizes (company-stated). Its homepage shows a "Progress Podio Authorised Partner" badge. Founded Aug 2014, Germany.
imageAlt: Cloud Backup for Podio product image

mentions.evidence: ~$2,397 MRR (−3.3% L30), 36 active subscriptions, ~$2,156 L30, ~$27,438 last 12 months, ~$361,502 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 7, 2026 ~04:18 Warsaw (02:18 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: "Backup for a platform that forgot backups." Look for sticky business apps with APIs but weak export/restore: Airtable, Monday, ClickUp, Pipedrive, Fakturownia/inFakt in PL, Optima/Subiekt data. Per-workspace pricing, nightly snapshots, one-click restore of a deleted record.

whyItPrints: A legacy platform with loyal business users and business-critical data, and a third-party backup that fills the gap. Customers buy it as insurance and never think about it again. 36 subs at ~$67/mo average (my calculation). It's slowly shrinking with Podio's own user base, but it has paid for 12 years.
